title: Tsawwassen First Nation ends Truth and Reconciliation event early due to 'critical incident'

items: The Tsawwassen First Nation has ended its event marking the National Day for Truth and Reconciliation early due to an ongoing incident, according to an alert.
The City of Delta, B.C., says the public should avoid the Tsawwassen Mills area, south of Vancouver.

blocks.text: There are no updates at the moment. They will appear here as soon as they are available. Stay tuned!
